summary: fix(settings): stop Sentry report on window focus without account
description:
Because:

* The Settings window focus handler read account.uid, and the Account.data getter sends a Sentry report before it throws when no account is stored.

This commit:

* Reads currentAccount() on focus and goes to / when it has no uid.
* Removes the dead uid comparison and setCurrentAccount branch.
* Adds unit tests and a functional test for the focus redirect.

Closes FXA-14837
